title: Command recovery and updater fixes
summary: Fewer stuck commands, better Stop/Continue recovery and more reliable updates.
improved: Commands now have a total time limit, including waiting for their helper. Long-running add-on tools keep their existing time allowances.
A new request after Stop waits for the previous operation to finish safely.
fixed: Stale thinking indicators and lost extension replies can no longer keep commands waiting forever.
Windows updates use a fresh built-in helper and can run under a restricted local PowerShell policy without changing the system policy.
notes: Live signed-in provider accounts and every user installation have not been verified.

sections.title: 🛠️ Commands and recovery
items: **Fewer stuck tools:** fixes waiting loops caused by stale thinking indicators, missing replies and noisy helpers.
**Stop and continue:** keeps your new request while the previous operation finishes. Commands are not automatically repeated.
**Long tasks:** add-on tools keep their existing time allowances.

sections.title: 🔄 More reliable updates
items: **Fresh updater:** uses the helper included with the current build instead of an outdated installed copy.
**Windows fix:** allows the verified update helper to run without changing your system’s PowerShell policy.
**Safety checks:** download checksums, backups and rollback stay in place.

sections.title: ✅ Checked before release
items: Browser and platform regression checks, Windows update tests and the macOS desktop lifetime check. Live account behavior remains unverified.
